pluralExactly: the app shows this form only when the number is exactly {value}
pluralNumbers: the app shows this form when the number is {numbers}
pluralDecimals: the app shows this form only for fractions such as {numbers}: no whole number reaches it
genderChosen: the app shows this form to users who chose “{gender}” as their gender in the settings: make every word that refers to the user agree with it
genderUnspecified: the app shows this form to users who have not chosen a gender: do not guess one, and do not join two endings with a slash or brackets; reword the sentence so that nothing in it depends on the user's gender
genderless: the target language does not mark grammatical gender, so every user sees this one form, whatever gender they chose: write it without gender agreement
neverTranslate: Never translate, keep exactly as written: {terms}
outdated: the source changed after this was translated: the target below is the old translation, so bring it in line with the new source instead of keeping it
